title: dcposch/jc2-lean
summary: Lean 4 / Mathlib proof of the source-facing polynomial-cube exclusion at actual partial degrees (6,9). From literal bivariate polynomials of outer degrees six and nine, leading coefficients s^6 and s^9 for a common polynomial s, and nonzero constant Keller bracket, the formalization proves that no such source exists, including when s is constant. It constructs the finite-pole or infinity expansion, exhausts every timing of the eight Faber loads through rho2, and excludes the remaining elliptic, cusp, zero-invariant, and constant-core terminal fibres.
